evidence_notes: This is a fresh 2026-10-23 roster/state verification. Earlier predictions are not treated as evidence.
Spelling/case of handles is normalized across reports (e.g. knight, Xun, POUT, kyeahoo, Zest) without changing player identity.
The source roster list is pre-match and does not prove the final submitted five for an individual game.
All starting roles have at least one opened esports source; LCK starters, BLG Bin/Viper, T1 Peyz, DK Smash and the TES top-lane substitution were explicitly cross-checked.
No analyst power rankings, betting odds, Reddit comments, unverified training results, or speculative visa updates enter the team/state files.
The data contains only player handles, team mappings, dates and short factual paraphrases; no article text is reproduced.
Source web references are retrieval provenance. Stable URLs are the primary reusable citations.
